title: DeepSeek Ultracode and smoother Notion startup
summary: A focused DeepSeek thinking mode, less repeated work and more reliable Notion startup.
added: DeepSeek has its own Ultracode method with 13 context-aware Roblox skills. Replies follow your latest request’s language.
improved: DeepSeek Ultracode receives its full method once per confirmed conversation session, then uses short reminders. Other providers keep the existing global Ultracode method.
Notion starts with a short handshake and receives the full task rules with the existing tool-list reply. No extra startup round trip is added.
fixed: Firefox now receives the complete Notion paste payload when the browser creates a separate clipboard transfer.
Startup errors stop safely and release the chat lock. The agent only becomes ready after the required handshake succeeds.
notes: Production-code browser fixtures pass in Chromium and Firefox. Live signed-in provider latency and all account-specific behavior have not been verified.

sections.title: 🧠 DeepSeek Ultracode
items: **13 skills:** a focused Roblox method, including safer data saving, UI and API checks. Replies use your language.
**Less repeated work:** sends the full method once per session, then uses short reminders. Keeps careful checks and asks once before an unapproved large build.
**Other AIs:** keep the existing Ultracode method.

sections.title: ⚡ Smoother Notion startup
items: **Shorter first message:** startup uses a small handshake. Full task instructions follow in the existing tool-list reply.
**Firefox fix:** startup pastes now carry the complete message.
**Error recovery:** failed startup releases the chat lock. PlazCode only says it is ready after the handshake succeeds.

sections.title: ✅ Checked before release
items: Chromium, Firefox and platform regression checks, plus the macOS desktop lifetime check. Live signed-in account behavior remains unverified.
